sources.title: Local Government Act 1972, section 100B — Access to agenda and connected reports
sources.version_or_date: 1972 c.70, s.100B; current text must be rechecked before operational use

freshness.review_trigger: Before operational use; on amendment, commencement change or material legal question

reuse.notes: Primary legislation may be quoted only as needed; this registry stores a concise proposition rather than a bulk copy.

limitations: Applicability depends on authority/body/meeting type and current amendments.
Does not establish an organisation's internal drafting, clearance or publication workflow.

sources.title: Local Authorities (Executive Arrangements) (Meetings and Access to Information) (England) Regulations 2012
sources.version_or_date: S.I. 2012/2089; current text and amendments must be rechecked before operational use

freshness.review_trigger: Before operational use; on amendment, commencement change or material legal question

reuse.notes: Registry stores a bounded summary, not a duplicate of the instrument.

limitations: Applies only to decision-making bodies and authorities within the Regulations' scope.
Does not itself establish local delegations, committee terms of reference or internal deadlines.

sources.title: ADSO Training Programme — Meetings Procedures and Law & Practice

freshness.review_trigger: When ADSO materially changes the programme or before relying on a specific course proposition

reuse.notes: Only public page propositions are captured; member-only/course materials are not ingested.

limitations: Evidence of professional learning/practice topics, not a binding local procedural rule.
Course descriptions do not substitute for the underlying law, constitution or competent legal advice.

sources.title: Working in a Modern Democracy
sources.version_or_date: Programme page; includes 2024 report and continuing programme

freshness.review_trigger: When ADSO publishes a material programme/report update

limitations: Supports improvement thinking; does not determine a council's powers, constitution or meeting procedure.

sources.title: Knowles on Local Authority Meetings, 8th edition

freshness.review_trigger: If a licensed/current edition is supplied for authorised use

reuse.notes: Do not bulk-copy, index or reproduce commercial text without an appropriate licence or user-supplied lawful access.
